mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS has declined for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 4.0% for two consecutive months, it signals a weakening labor market that reduces corporate hiring and wage growth, leading to lower earnings expectations and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where UNRATE has exceeded 4.0% for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and residential sales (RSAFS) indicates a contraction in the housing sector, which is a leading indicator of reduced consumer spending and economic activity, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS (both down > 0.5% MoM) fails to predict negative SPX 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: During a period of slowing industrial production (INDPRO growth below 0.5% YoY), the manufacturing sector's weakness signals a decelerating economy, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as investors anticipate reduced corporate profits.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where INDPRO growth is below 0.5% YoY.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year change in CPI exceeds 3.0%, it signals persistent inflation that prompts the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as higher rates pressure equity valuations.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where CPIAUCSL YoY growth exceeds 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A rising trend in housing starts (HOUST) indicates strong consumer confidence and economic expansion, which boosts corporate revenues and leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where HOUST is rising (MoM > 0.5%).

mechanism_narrative: A rising trend in industrial production (INDPRO) signals robust manufacturing activity and economic growth, which supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where INDPRO is rising (MoM > 0.5%).

mechanism_narrative: When the monthly change in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) exceeds 200,000, it signals a strong labor market that accelerates wage growth and inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to tighten policy, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where PAYEMS MoM growth exceeds 200,000.
